plan: Given my value of $48, the optimal strategy is to bid slightly below this value to maximize profit while still having a high chance of winning. Bidding my full value ensures no profit. To outbid others without overpaying, I'll bid slightly above the midpoint of the potential range of other bidders' values, around $24.5. A bid of $40 should balance winning likelihood and profitability, considering rational opponents will also not exceed their values.

Given my value of $38, I should bid slightly below my value to maximize profit while considering the risk of losing. Bidding exactly my value or slightly below (e.g., $37.9) ensures I win if others bid lower. Rational bidders will also bid below their value, so bidding just below my value maximizes the chance of winning without overpaying.

Since this is the only round, I aim to maximize profit by setting my bid below my value but high enough to outbid a rational opponent. My private value is $12. I will bid slightly below to ensure a potential profit margin if I win. Given the rationality of others, they will likely bid slightly under their values too. A bid of $10 should be competitive, allowing for a profit if I win against slightly lower bids.
